title: 基于RGB-D实例分割与几何不确定性建模的六自由度机器人抓取选择研究

populations.unit_for_resampling: R6 base_scene (object-position-repetition), keeping its observations and methods together

source_policy: Original V1 per-file locks, final04 packaging only; data from R6/R7; no V2/V3

input_design.single: split the positive horizontal shift, axial Gaussian, iid missing mask and rectangle composed in frozen joint. Reproduce the complete per-scene frozen joint draw order and seed when extracting a single realization. Settings, RGB, sampling seed, pose and stable state unchanged.
input_design.rect: one randomly positioned rectangle height h//4 width w//4 on the 480x640 depth image

ranking_measurement.pose_match: Pair admissibility: original frozen GraspNet NMS on just two original physical poses, threshold 0.03m and pi/6. Bipartite assignment: maximize number matched then minimize total normalized translation and minimum parallel-jaw rotation angle. Deterministic source order. Also report exact equality of width, height, depth, rotation and translation separately. No matching based on success, risk or score.
ranking_measurement.top1: top of pre-E ranked pool and separately first in the frozen executable set E. Both absent: no selection, not a pose match. One absent: presence change. Both present but unmatched: changed pose.
ranking_measurement.overlap: Jaccard of matched Top-K identities plus overlap coefficient on available lists; when both empty undefined. Matched-pair Kendall tau-b on scientific scores, tied scores stay tied. Also stable-order Kendall on common candidates; fewer than two or all ties => undefined.
ranking_measurement.sampling: For each new condition form a scene unit if any method pre-E Top-1 is unmatched to clean or presence changes. Freeze unit hash order SHA256(version|robustness|exact_unit_id); take up to 6 per single factor; dispatch all Raw,A,C0 without replacement. No backfill or substitution.

diagnostics.strata: Independent candidate-path identity = within scene/condition frozen observed candidate geometry and stable state, geometry and kinematic plan; collapse repeated methods. Canonical representative method from hash-sorted members, independent of outcome inside each specified frame. Cyclic water-filling across object, condition and representative method, seed-keyed order, then hash rank within each stratum. Record population, inclusion weights, original methods, assigned counts and probability.

uncertified.override: Only absence/numerical non-certification of the contact-entry certificate. Keep early contact, identity, finite checks, registered surface geometry, non-pad collision, proxy penetration, the whole V1 path and dynamic evaluator. Other gates remain decisive. Never assert an unobserved certificate.

negatives.from: affirmative registered early contact or forbidden collision, indicated by frozen raw witness, not numerical noncertification alone

diagnostics.truth: Completed grasp success is distinct from mechanical executability. Report certified-vs-grasp table only where a new physical outcome is observed, plus safety-stopped and not-executed/unknown separately. Provide both number rescued / 40 (and verified subset) and false rejection FN/(TP+FN) within diagnostic verified sample. Control-enriched sample cannot estimate an unweighted formal population FNR, specificity or sensitivity. Publish stratum-based estimates only where inclusion and verification support them.

analysis.interval: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap at base scene level. Resample clusters with replacement, retaining all relevant joint/clean, method, control rows together. Undefined denominator / no informative clusters => null and reported. No iid binomial CI.
analysis.risk_coverage: Empirical selective execution failure among selected recorded trials, against all assigned trials. Frozen A/C0 or ablation collision_proxy ascending, and all methods including Raw scored confidence descending; joint ties inseparable. Display coverage zero with undefined risk; no outcome for unexecuted alternative inferred.
analysis.score_outcome: rank and signed score margin to closest runner-up in old E, report ties and singleton separately. Prespecified finite empirical quartiles using scores only with tied predictions inseparable, descriptive score/rank association vs static admission and success, cluster intervals.
analysis.comparison: R6 main denominator 240/method and R7 80/method; paired six-way comparison restricted to 80 shared R7 unit IDs; separate new outcomes.

stop: Any real frozen hash change, nonfinite input/return, unknown physics or disk error stops. No modification of scientific gates beyond the explicitly authorized diagnostic-only omission for the 40. No new objects or follow-on experiments.
